Docs.summary: Create and use passkeys (WebAuthn / FIDO2 public-key credentials) with the native platform authenticator (Face ID / Touch ID / Windows Hello / Android biometric).
Docs.remarks: This API brokers the standard WebAuthn JSON between a relying-party (RP) server and the OS authenticator. The server produces the options JSON and verifies the response JSON; this API only drives the native UI. It does not perform any server-side verification, attestation validation, or challenge generation.
